description: Presents a list of mutually exclusive choices.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible accessible group label; no fieldset is created.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Radio group name used on generated inputs.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: 1-based index of the checked item (`""` for no selection).

methods.name: reset(): void
methods.description: Resets selected item to the initial value.

events.name: tp-radio-list-change
events.description: Emitted after a selection change. value is the selected 1-based item index as a string; label is its visible label. Both are empty when nothing is selected.

cssproperties.name: --tp-radio-list-marker-gap
cssproperties.description: Horizontal space between each selection marker and its item content.

cssproperties.name: --tp-radio-list-marker-width
cssproperties.description: Width reserved for each selection marker; aligns the item content in both orientations.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-radio-list>` element presents a list of mutually exclusive choices.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Option | Click to select one option and replace the previous selection. |
| Hover | Highlights an enabled option without changing its selection. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | <kbd>Enter</kbd> or leave the group. |
| <kbd>←</kbd>/<kbd>↑</kbd>/<kbd>→</kbd>/<kbd>↓</kbd> | Move and select among enabled radio options. |
| <kbd>Space</kbd> | Select the focused option. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
